data.gender_notes: Karthick is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Karthick is recorded with the meaning “God of War”. Karthick is a Hindu name meaning “God of War”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.

in_sanskrit.name: Karthikeya
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The son of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati, often depicted as the younger brother of Lord Murugan.

in_hindi.name: कृत्थिक
in_hindi.long_meaning: कृत्तिकाकुमार है सिवायां और पार्वती के संतोष्जनक पुत्र, जो सद्योजात मुरुगन के YOUNGER भाई के रूप में दिखता है।

in_tamil.name: கர்திஹிக்
in_tamil.long_meaning: கல்லர் வர்க்கு இல்லோர் கழுவிய கர்த்திக்குக் கள்ளிருந்தது.

in_telugu.name: కృష్ఠిఖ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: శోదోశ్చేద్దేశ్ ఇదు శివాయోభోయేదే పర్వతీయోభోయే శుశ్ష్కేదేశ్ దేశీయోభోయే దేశీయే దేశోయే దేశీయే దేశిన పుత్రయే.

in_marathi.name: Karthick
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of War
in_marathi.long_meaning: Karthick हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is a god in war and battles, a warrior

in_bengali.name: Karthick
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of War
in_bengali.long_meaning: Karthick একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is a god in war and battles, a warrior
